categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in data analysis and digital product services, providing integrated data research, analysis, intelligent application technology products, and industry digital solutions. It serves large and medium-sized commercial enterprises and government/public service institutions, focusing on business decision-making, marketing, product innovation, production operations, customer service, and urban governance. The business includes professional data analysis services, digital marketing SaaS products, and industry digital solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include data science, AI, AIGC (AI Generated Content), machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and large language models. The company develops proprietary industry-specific data analysis models and intelligent applications, integrating multi-dimensional and heterogeneous data. Production involves data acquisition, fusion, analysis, and application, delivered through professional services, SaaS platforms, and digital transformation solutions. The company actively invests in AI and AIGC technologies to enhance product intelligence and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large-scale commercial enterprises, including Fortune 500 companies, and government/public service agencies. The company focuses on industries such as telecommunications, ICT, fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), automotive, finance, tobacco, healthcare, agriculture, and public services like urban management. It targets business decision-makers and operational users requiring data-driven insights and digital transformation solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant business in regions including North China, East China, South China, Central China, and Southwest China. It also has a presence overseas through a wholly-owned subsidiary in Singapore. The majority of revenue and operations are concentrated in domestic Chinese markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the data value chain, focusing on data analysis, application, and consulting services. It acts as a data service provider and technology enabler, leveraging data supplied by upstream entities such as governments, telecom operators, and large enterprises, and delivering value-added data products and solutions to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI and AIGC technologies, developing industry-specific intelligent data analysis models, and expanding SaaS-based digital marketing and experience management products. The company emphasizes R&D in large language models, multi-modal AI capabilities, and AI agent applications to enhance business intelligence and operational efficiency. It also focuses on expanding digital transformation solutions in agriculture, tobacco, and other verticals, with ongoing investments in intelligent data collection and analysis platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of professional data analysis services, subscription and licensing of SaaS products, and delivery of customized industry digital solutions. The company employs a direct sales model, engaging clients through supplier lists and bidding processes. It also derives income from investment returns and financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China's data analysis and digital intelligence service market, with a strong reputation among large commercial and government clients. It competes with domestic and international data analytics and AI service providers, leveraging its proprietary AI models and industry expertise. Its competitive advantages include deep industry knowledge, advanced AI integration, and a broad client base including Fortune 500 companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 539 million, representing an 8.27% year-over-year increase, with a compound annual growth rate of 16.02% since 2020. Despite revenue growth, the company incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 170 million, mainly due to provisions for potential litigation and credit impairment losses. The company maintains total assets of approximately RMB 1.2 billion and has invested significantly in R&D, with expenditures accounting for 8.47% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its integration of advanced AI and data science technologies with deep industry-specific data models, enabling intelligent, multi-dimensional data analysis and application. Its proprietary AIGC large language models and AI agent platforms provide enhanced business insights and operational efficiencies. The company offers comprehensive, standardized SaaS products and customized digital solutions that empower clients to realize the value of data as a core production factor, supporting digital transformation and intelligent business operations.
